externalSources.title: Rapport no 1479 concernant l’organisation des élections en France, Tome I
externalSources.locator: Tome I, historical discussion of suffrage, paragraph beginning Le 21 septembre 1792; rendered text line 929
externalSources.evidenceText: Le 21 septembre 1792, au lendemain de la victoire de Valmy, la Convention nationale proclamera pour la première fois en France la République.
externalSources.evidenceInterpretation: The official report explicitly states that France first proclaimed the Republic in 1792. The proposed sentence retains the original century-level precision without asserting an uninterrupted republic.

externalSources.evidenceText: L'ère française commence au 22 septembre 1792, jour de la fondation de la République.
externalSources.evidenceInterpretation: The historical constitution names 22 September 1792 as the foundation date. The candidate intentionally says late eighteenth century and therefore does not force a distinction between the proclamation and the calendar epoch.
